# cpanel_email_domains (Data Source)

Reads the complete normalized cPanel mail domain inventory through `Email::list_mail_domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `domains` (List of String) The normalized mail domains in sorted order.
